independence: Separate stdlib implementation; uses disjoint-set graph reconstruction, scalar joins and quantile/RMS reaggregation from preserved tables. Not independent data, external peer review or physical-origin validation.
scientific_cautions: Fixed catalog FWHM and nominal lambda/R are templates/scales, never measured intrinsic widths.
Graph components describe positional proximity/window dependence and cannot count independent physical sources.
Multiple events share discovery/comparison spectra; event-row correlations and residual RMS are not significance or origin probabilities.
Low-continuum flags and short BERV spans remain explicit. Nonflagged cases are not validated.
All current U labels are preserved in these outputs; this audit is of the frozen batch04 source snapshot.
